about: TextRoundTripCorpus (kernel/tests/Shared/TextRoundTripTests.cs): the fixed point of ssam-flow/1 over corpus.json, per lane. The O11 and ODC numbers add up to the plan's table 6.5 (C:\Users\andre\SSAM-analises\html-do-ssam\PLANO.md): 5,240 actions, 50,305 nodes, every node kind, and every authored value the digest of 16d95076 lost (counted). Sizes: structure = the text without its descriptions (///), comments and continuation lines (|) against the whole digest of the same actions; median = the median per action of the whole text against the digest's text of that action.

odc.medianNote: The ODC actions carry long descriptions and comments the digest cut or never showed (screen action descriptions, template comments): with them the median is 1.437 (measured 2026-10-11, LG1); the structure alone is within 1.25. The corpus as a whole (both lanes) has a median of 1.24. LG2 (2026-10-11): 1.447, because 9 template actions (UpdateUser, SendResetPasswordEmail, SendChangeEmail in three apps) write @{Call=Server}: a client flow calling the server action whose name its client action shares, which the way back needs to choose the action. Owner header (2026-10-12, extractor 5): 1.477, because the header of the 620 screen and data actions names its screen or block (action Home.Save), which a new one needs to be born from its text; the ceiling went from 1.45 to 1.50 for that (O11: 1.220 -> 1.246, within its 1.25).
